text.p: Health Management Inc said Friday the forebearance agreement relating to its credit agreement has been extended to December 23, and that the availability under its revolving line of credit has been further increased by up to $2 million.

The extension of the forebearance agreement was granted by Transworld Home Healthcare Inc, the holder of the senior debt, in connection with an extension of the anticipated closing date for Transworld's purchase 49 percent of Health Management to December 23, with an option to purchase an additional two percent.
That agreement was announced in November.

The closing of the stock purchase agreement is subject to certain conditions, including preliminary court approval of a revised settlement of a stockholders' consolidated class action lawsuit for a $7.2 million cash payment, as well as approval by Transworld's bank.
Health Management also said it will delay filing its quarterly report for the second quarter ended October 31, 1996 until December 20, 1996.
Health Management shares fell 1/16 to 1-1/8 Friday and Transworld fell 1/8 to 11-5/8.
